title: The Little Lion's Roar | Kids Song & Nursery Rhymes for Toddlers | BuBu TV - English
description:
A little lion learns that being kind is stronger than being loud.
This sing-along rhyme teaches toddlers about friendship, sharing, and helping others.
Grab the kids, sing along, and roar softly together!

The little lion roars so loud
the birds fly far away
roar, roar, roar, roar!
Oh my, what a noisy day!

Roar roar big, shh shh soft
a kind lion is strong
roar, roar, shh, shh
kind lion, come along!

Nobody wants to play with him
he sits all by himself
sad, sad, sad, sad
no friends to share his shelf!

Roar roar big, shh shh soft
a kind lion is strong
roar, roar, shh, shh
kind lion, come along!

A baby rabbit's stuck, oh no
the lion hears its cry
soft, soft, soft, soft
the rabbit hops up high!

Roar roar big, shh shh soft
a kind lion is strong
roar, roar, shh, shh
kind lion, come along!

Amma claps, "Come play, come play!"
all the animals come near
hop, hop, skip, skip
the kind little lion is here!
